baseline_suite and after_suite both run only tests/test_a_coordinator_gate_shows_on_its_pane.py at 4ee282df51 and e690958f2d, while §95's done-when also holds the files importing reckon.crew.recovery_watch and reckon.crew.lift_watch, and those exercising crew verify-gate and crew suite run, to no added failure; the related-file run the manifest cites (related-suite.log, 60 files, 1034 passed, 2 failed) predates the repair's renderer change at f5883f817c, so that change carries no delta measurement of its own.

the fragment still states the 87 related files pass with 644 passed, but the only surviving related log holds a 60-file run of 1034 passed, 2 failed, so a reader cannot reconcile the artifact's gate result with any log; this was raised in the earlier review of this run and still stands in the file this commit edits.
